description: As a GIS technologist, you need to prepare the Sentinel-2 RGB imagery (sentinel2_b432.tif in /home/ga/snap_data/) for integration into a topographic mapping project that requires data in a projected coordinate system with metric units. The imagery is currently in a geographic coordinate system. Transform it to an appropriate map projection, and create a spatial subset focusing on a smaller region of interest within the scene. Save the reprojected and subsetted product in BEAM-DIMAP format, and export the map-ready product as GeoTIFF to /home/ga/snap_exports/.
